decisions.reason: Correcting which domains or websites map to which Wix profiles does not change the requirement that locations use separate Wix websites and accounts.
The source corrects domain-to-account mapping but does not change the selector, location options, or rule that each selection routes to the corresponding location website.
Switching websites or connecting domains to the correct accounts does not alter the reusable template strategy or future-location addition rules.
The mapping correction does not change the requirement for dedicated, consistently branded location experiences.
The source does not change the master site's national brand role or its rule that bookings are handled by sibling location sites.
Correct domain and profile mapping supports the existing architecture but does not change any booking, reporting, database, analytics, membership, gift-card, or access isolation rule.
The source does not modify the required separation of location payment setups or payouts; it only resolves which domain or website belongs to the correct account.
Domain and Wix-profile mapping has no necessary effect on the selected design references, visual style, or cross-location design consistency.
The source does not change the Wix booking platform, booking host, or Seattle booking activation rules.
Correcting domain-to-account mapping does not alter the master homepage's required sections or presentation of offerings.
The mapping resolution has no effect on the mobile-friendly design requirement.
Switching websites or connecting domains to the correct Wix accounts does not change the required brand name, colors, logo usage, or cross-location branding.
